crossRefs.note: The king said, “Get me a sword.” So they brought a sword before the king.

translations.web: The king said, “Get me a sword.” So they brought a sword before the king.
translations.bsb: The king continued, “Bring me a sword.” So they brought him a sword,
translations.kjv: And the king said, Bring me a sword. And they brought a sword before the king.
translations.asv: And the king said, Fetch me a sword. And they brought a sword before the king.
